label: Ruckus T310c outdoor Wi-Fi 6 access point
description: Ruckus T310c - outdoor 2x2:2 802.11ac Wave 2 access point, one 1GbE RJ-45 port with 802.3af/at PoE input (7.92 W max), IP67, -20 to 65 C, wind survivability to 266 km/h, wall/pole/drop-ceiling mount, 512 clients and 31 SSIDs.
notes: Source is CommScope/Ruckus's own **HTML datasheet** (`webresources.ruckuswireless.com/datasheets/<slug>/ds-ruckus-<slug>.html`), whose **PHYSICAL INTERFACES** table is machine-readable text - the 4gon product pages for these APs return no extractable content and the AP pages on ruckusnetworks.com are script-driven. **The T310 datasheet is a four-column table and the columns are not equivalent**, so the model has to say which one it is: Ethernet is '1 x 1GbE port, RJ-45' across `T310c/d/s/n`, but the USB 2.0 port and the 12V DC terminal block belong to `T310d`, `T310s` and `T310n` only, and the power draw differs too - 7.92 W on PoE for the `T310c` against 11.86 W for the others. This spec is the **T310c**: one port, PoE only, no DC terminal. **Peak PHY rates are published per band here** - '2.4GHz: 300Mbps, 5GHz: 867Mbps' - which is why, unusually for this batch, both radios carry a `speed`. 512 clients, 31 SSIDs per AP, BeamFlex+.
